description:
Web Content Developer
Leavenworth, KS
Full Time
Entry Level
 SHARE
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Web Content Developer to support the Army University Press in the development, remediation, and publication of high-quality academic and professional content across digital platforms.
The ideal candidate will have strong experience converting Adobe InDesign publications into accessible HTML and PDF formats, with a thorough understanding of HTML5, CSS3, WCAG, PDF/UA, and Section 508 accessibility standards. This position requires exceptional attention to detail, strong technical and communication skills, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a deadline-driven environment.

MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN & ON-SITE WORK REQUIRED
                          
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Convert and publish content from Adobe InDesign to accessible HTML and PDF formats.
Develop, maintain, and edit clean, semantic HTML5 and CSS3 using code editors.
Ensure all web and PDF content adheres to WCAG 2.1, PDF/UA, and Section 508 compliance standards.
Use code editors to develop and maintain clean, semantic HTML5 and CSS3 code.
Remediate PDF documents using accessibility tools, including PAC 2024 Checker and similar testing tools.
Utilize text-to-speech (TTS) tools to produce accessible audio formats from textual content.
Optimize titles, headings, metadata, URLs, internal links, and structured data to support traditional and generative search.
Manage content updates using DotNetNuke (DNN) or similar CMS platforms.
Apply User Experience (UX) and Search Engine Optimization (SEO) best practices.
Analyze digital engagement and content performance using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and social media analytics.
Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to promote digital accessibility across platforms.
Stay current with evolving web technologies, accessibility laws, and federal standards.

Education and Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Web Design, Graphic Design, or a related field is preferred.
Equivalent education, training, or relevant professional experience may be considered.
Skills and Qualifications
Web Development — HTML & CSS
Experience creating and maintaining webpages using HTML and CSS.
Strong understanding of responsive web design and cross-browser compatibility.
Experience with Bootstrap layouts, grids, components, and responsive design.
Ability to embed and format videos, audio, QR codes, and other multimedia resources.
Ability to format complex publication elements for the web, including footnotes, endnotes, quotations, sidebars, references, and citations.
Strong proofreading, editing, and quality-control skills.
Working knowledge of JavaScript is a plus.
 
Accessibility & Section 508
In-depth knowledge of WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards.
Experience developing, testing, and remediating webpages for accessibility compliance.
Experience creating and remediating accessible PDFs in accordance with PDF/UA and Section 508 requirements.
Familiarity with accessibility testing and remediation tools and techniques.
Ability to create accessible links, tables, lists, headings, captions, images, forms, and multimedia content.
Adobe Creative & Digital Publishing
Demonstrated experience with Adobe InDesign for the layout and production of digital journals, publications, or similar content.
Experience converting InDesign content into accessible digital formats.
Proficiency with Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.
Experience creating and editing web graphics, banners, and social media visuals.
Ability to optimize images for web use while maintaining quality and efficient load times.
AEO, GEO, SEO & Analytics
Understanding of how search engines and generative AI systems discover, interpret, and cite web content.
Experience optimizing titles, headings, metadata, URLs, internal links, and other on-page content.
Familiarity with structured data and other techniques that help search engines and AI systems understand digital content.
Knowledge of emerging generative-search and AI-search behavior.
Experience using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and/or similar digital analytics platforms.
Content Management & Social Media
Experience managing content through DotNetNuke (DNN) or a similar CMS.
Experience creating and managing content for social media platforms, including X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.
Ability to develop and execute social media content strategies aligned with organizational goals.
Familiarity with social media management platforms for scheduling, analytics, monitoring, and engagement.
Generative Audio & Text-to-Speech
Experience with text-to-speech or generative audio tools is a plus.
Ability to prepare written content for accessible audio production.
Understanding of accessibility considerations for digital audio content.
Core Competencies
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong proofreading and editing abilities.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to establish priorities and manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills.
Ability to provide and receive constructive feedback.
Strong sense of urgency and accountability.
Ability to follow established policies, procedures, technical standards, and accessibility requirements.
Demonstrated commitment to accuracy, consistency, and high-quality work.
Other Qualifications
Must be a United States citizen and able to successfully pass a required background investigation.
Must be able to meet the requirements for access to and work on a military installation.
Must possess a valid state-issued driver's license and maintain required automobile insurance.
Must be dependable, punctual, and able to maintain regular attendance as scheduled.
Must be able to effectively manage multiple priorities and meet established deadlines.
Must be able to communicate clearly and professionally, both orally and in writing.

Perks & Benefits
We offer competitive benefits and compensation package including paid time off, paid holidays, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, voluntary life insurance, legal benefits, identity theft protection, health savings account, education reimbursement, learning and development reimbursement, company-paid basic life insurance, company-paid short-term disability, and a 401(k) plan with a company match.

About nFocus Solutions
nFocus Solutions is dedicated to the development of innovative technologies and intelligent business solutions for the public sector. We are a leading provider of applications, services, and technologies that nonprofit organizations, communities, first responders and government agencies rely on to deliver services to the public at large. Our high-quality data management and analysis software enables our clients to achieve clear, well-defined results that change the world.

Voluntary Self-Identification of Disability
Voluntary Self-Identification of Disability Form CC-305
OMB Control Number 1250-0005
Expires 07/31/2029
Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at www.dol.gov/ofccp.

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
Blind or low vision
Cancer (past or present)
Cardiovascular or heart disease
Celiac disease
Cerebral palsy
Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
Diabetes
Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome
Intellectual or developmental disability
Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD
Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports
Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)
Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities
Partial or complete paralysis (any cause)
Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for example, tuberculosis, asthma, emphysema
Short stature (dwarfism)
Traumatic brain injury
